fleet.default_max_instances: 128,000 MB (Guangzhou/Shanghai/Beijing/Chengdu/HK) or 64,000 MB (Singapore/Tokyo/Silicon Valley/Frankfurt) of memory per region

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: The platform will repossess instances that have not processed requests for a certain period of time.
snapshot_auto.note: Idle instances are simply reclaimed; state is lost. /tmp (512 MB default, up to 10 GB paid) survives only while a warm instance is reused. No checkpoint-on-stop is documented anywhere in SCF docs.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: Because of the nature of SCF, you must write your function code in a stateless style. State characteristics in the lifecycle of a function such as local file storage will be destroyed after the function invocation ends.
snapshot_on_demand.note: No snapshot, checkpoint or SnapStart-like feature in the SCF docs, and the SCF API data types (VpcConfig, CfsConfig, PublicNetConfigIn, ...) have no Snapshot structure. Provisioned concurrency pre-warms instances; that is not a snapshot. Tencent's separate Agent Runtime product (AGS) advertises session snapshots, but it is not SCF.

harness_api.quote: The SCF platform is responsible for the creation, management, and deletion of all function runtime instances, and you have no permissions to manage them.
harness_api.note: SCF only runs functions (event, web, async up to 24 h). It has no API to drive Claude Code, Codex or another agent harness. Tencent's agent-sandbox product is Agent Runtime / Agent Sandbox (cloud.tencent.com/product/ags, 'VM 级隔离', '会话快照'). It is a separate product, not on this card, and worth its own provider id.

egress_allowlist.quote: 部署在 VPC 中的云函数默认隔离外网。
egress_allowlist.note: SCF's own control is coarse: public network access is an on/off switch (API PublicNetConfigIn.PublicNetStatus 'DISABLE'/'ENABLE'). A VPC-only function with public access off has no internet, so this is a no-internet mode. Instances live in the platform's VPC and reach your VPC through a function gateway that SNATs to one IP in your subnet (FAQ 583/55718). Internet via your VPC therefore goes through your NAT gateway, where VPC-level IP controls apply. That last point is derived: SCF's VpcConfig has only VpcId/SubnetId and no security-group field. There is no domain allowlist. A fixed egress EIP is available.

ingress_rules.quote: CAM 鉴权：需要对函数 CAM 鉴权验证，用户可以基于函数 InvokeFunctionUrl 接口进行资源管理和使用权限配置。
ingress_rules.note: There are no raw inbound ports; the only ingress is invocation. Function URLs are off by default. Each URL can be public (https://<app-id>-<url-id>.<region>.tencentscf.com) and/or VPC-internal (.in.<region>.tencentscf.com, per 583/96099), with auth set to CAM (signed) or NONE (open). Other invocation paths are the TencentCloud API InvokeFunction (CAM) and API Gateway/CLB triggers. No IP allowlist on function URLs is documented.

secret_proxy.quote: External storage of encrypted information: Keys related to authentication and encryption can be extracted from the code into environment variables, avoiding security risks caused by the presence of relevant keys hard-coded in the code.
secret_proxy.note: Secrets are plain env vars. Execution-role temporary credentials are also put into the function as env vars (TENCENTCLOUD_SECRETID / SECRETKEY / SESSIONTOKEN), so the real credentials enter the instance. There is no injecting proxy.

volume_attach.quote: Tencent Cloud SCF can be seamlessly integrated with CFS. After proper configuration, your functions can easily access files stored in CFS.
volume_attach.note: Network file systems only (CFS General and CFS Turbo series, mounted under /mnt/, per 583/122883 and 583/46199). The function must be in the same VPC as the CFS mount target, and CFS is billed separately by CFS. There are no block volumes. Ephemeral /tmp is 512 MB free, up to 10 GB paid.

volume_shared.quote: 多个函数可共用一个文件系统，实现文件共享。
volume_shared.note: Read-write NFS (the docs example writes /mnt/myfolder/filel.txt). It is shared across functions and concurrent instances, and also with CVM/TKE. Default mount uid/gid is 10000.

docker_inside.quote: The SCF platform is responsible for the creation, management, and deletion of all function runtime instances, and you have no permissions to manage them.
docker_inside.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. SCF lets you deploy a container image AS the function itself (image deployment), but there is no documented ability to run a nested Docker daemon inside a function instance; instances are ephemeral, unprivileged, stateless containers you cannot manage.

nested_virt.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. SCF runs functions in shared-kernel container instances (isolation=container); no /dev/kvm or nested-VM capability is documented for function runtimes.

desktop.quote: Tencent Cloud's Serverless Cloud Function (SCF) is a serverless execution environment that enables you to build and run applications without having to purchase and manage servers.
desktop.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. SCF is a stateless FaaS platform with no graphical desktop/VNC/RDP surface.

browser.quote: Tencent Cloud's Serverless Cloud Function (SCF) is a serverless execution environment that enables you to build and run applications without having to purchase and manage servers.
browser.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. No managed/real browser is provided as part of SCF.

computer_use.quote: Tencent Cloud's Serverless Cloud Function (SCF) is a serverless execution environment that enables you to build and run applications without having to purchase and manage servers.
computer_use.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. No screenshot/click driving API exists for a FaaS product with no desktop.

anti_bot.quote: Tencent Cloud's Serverless Cloud Function (SCF) is a serverless execution environment that enables you to build and run applications without having to purchase and manage servers.
anti_bot.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. SCF is generic function compute, not a browsing/scraping stealth product.

captcha_solving.quote: Tencent Cloud's Serverless Cloud Function (SCF) is a serverless execution environment that enables you to build and run applications without having to purchase and manage servers.
captcha_solving.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. No CAPTCHA-solving capability is part of a FaaS runtime.

egress_ip_type.quote: 部署在 VPC 中的云函数默认隔离外网。
egress_ip_type.note: Outbound traffic egresses via Tencent Cloud datacenter infrastructure (through your VPC's NAT/EIP or the platform's shared gateway). A fixed egress EIP option is documented (already reflected in the card's static_egress_ip:true), so this is static-datacenter, not residential/mobile.

ssh.quote: The SCF platform is responsible for the creation, management, and deletion of all function runtime instances, and you have no permissions to manage them.
ssh.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. There is no documented SSH access into function runtime instances; the platform explicitly reserves instance management to itself.

fork.quote: The SCF platform is responsible for the creation, management, and deletion of all function runtime instances, and you have no permissions to manage them.
fork.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. Function versions/aliases exist for code deployment, but there is no API to clone a running function instance/machine.

fork_running.quote: The SCF platform is responsible for the creation, management, and deletion of all function runtime instances, and you have no permissions to manage them.
fork_running.note: not offered: outside the product's scope; no fork capability at all (see fork).

memory_snapshot_fork.quote: Because of the nature of SCF, you must write your function code in a stateless style. State characteristics in the lifecycle of a function such as local file storage will be destroyed after the function invocation ends.
memory_snapshot_fork.note: not offered: card already establishes snapshot:none and snapshot_on_demand:false; there is no memory-snapshot cloning feature.

pause_resume.quote: The platform will repossess instances that have not processed requests for a certain period of time.
pause_resume.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. Idle instances are simply reclaimed/destroyed by the platform; there is no user-facing pause/resume control, only auto-stop-idle behavior via reclamation.

wake_on_request.quote: If there is no running instance when a request arrives, the request will trigger the startup of an instance.
wake_on_request.note: Core FaaS cold-start behavior: an incoming invocation automatically starts a new instance if none is warm.

persistent_disk.quote: Because of the nature of SCF, you must write your function code in a stateless style. State characteristics in the lifecycle of a function such as local file storage will be destroyed after the function invocation ends.
persistent_disk.note: The 512 MB /tmp space only survives while a warm instance happens to be reused, not guaranteed across stop/start; no true persistent local disk. (Network file storage via CFS is separate, already reflected as volume_attach/volume_shared.)

live_resize.quote: 计费项与计费方式...资源使用费用
live_resize.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. Memory/CPU allocation is a function configuration property set via update APIs (which redeploys the function config), not a live resize of a running instance.

agent_harnesses.quote: The SCF platform is responsible for the creation, management, and deletion of all function runtime instances, and you have no permissions to manage them.
agent_harnesses.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. SCF has no coding-agent (Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode) templates or preinstalled harnesses; its agent-oriented product is the separate Agent Runtime/Agent Sandbox offering, not modeled by this card.

own_agent_api.quote: Tencent Cloud's Serverless Cloud Function (SCF) is a serverless execution environment that enables you to build and run applications without having to purchase and manage servers.
own_agent_api.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. SCF has no first-party browser/computer-use/research task-agent API; that functionality (if any) lives in Tencent's separate Agent Runtime product, not SCF.

mcp_server.quote: Tencent Cloud's Serverless Cloud Function (SCF) is a serverless execution environment that enables you to build and run applications without having to purchase and manage servers.
mcp_server.note: No MCP server for controlling SCF sandboxes was found on SCF's docs/API pages.

lang_node.quote: Code Development Python Node.js Golang PHP Java Custom Runtime
lang_node.note: Node.js is a first-class supported runtime language for SCF code development, alongside Python, Go, PHP, and Java.

public_ipv4.quote: 部署在 VPC 中的云函数默认隔离外网。
public_ipv4.note: Functions are invoked via Function URLs (tencentscf.com domains) / API Gateway / TencentCloud API, not a dedicated public IPv4 per function instance. Outbound uses a shared gateway or an optional fixed EIP, not a per-machine public IPv4.

egress_http_rules.quote: 部署在 VPC 中的云函数默认隔离外网。
egress_http_rules.note: SCF's own egress control is only a coarse public-network on/off switch (PublicNetConfigIn.PublicNetStatus) plus VPC routing; no documented HTTP method/path-level egress rules.

guest_firewall.note: derived: SCF isolation is container (shared kernel), and the runtime instance is fully platform-managed with no root/instance access, so guest-side nftables/iptables control is not applicable/documented.

windows.quote: The current SCF execution environment is built based on the following: Standard CentOS 7.2
windows.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. SCF's documented execution environment is Linux (CentOS 7.2); no Windows function runtime is offered.

macos.quote: The current SCF execution environment is built based on the following: Standard CentOS 7.2
macos.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. SCF only offers Linux (CentOS-based) container runtimes.

self_host.quote: Tencent Cloud's Serverless Cloud Function (SCF) is a serverless execution environment that enables you to build and run applications without having to purchase and manage servers.
self_host.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. SCF is a fully managed hyperscaler service; there is no self-hosted/on-prem version.

byoc.quote: Tencent Cloud's Serverless Cloud Function (SCF) is a serverless execution environment that enables you to build and run applications without having to purchase and manage servers.
byoc.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. SCF runs only in Tencent Cloud's own infrastructure/regions, not deployed into a customer's own cloud account.

open_source.quote: Tencent Cloud's Serverless Cloud Function (SCF) is a serverless execution environment that enables you to build and run applications without having to purchase and manage servers.
open_source.note: SCF is a proprietary managed Tencent Cloud service; no OSI-licensed open-source release of the core platform is published.

soc2.quote: Tencent Cloud has established a robust security and compliance framework anchored in a shared responsibility model and validated by international certifications such as ISO 27001 and SOC.
soc2.note: Tencent Cloud lists SOC 1/SOC 2/SOC 3 reports among its independent third-party audited certifications, covering its cloud platform (including SCF's underlying infrastructure).

sso.quote: If you already have an account system for your organization, you can use the Identity Provider (IdP) feature to allow your organization members to access Tencent Cloud resources.
sso.note: Tencent Cloud CAM supports federated single sign-on via an Identity Provider (IdP) role feature at the account level, which applies to accessing/managing SCF like other Tencent Cloud services.

eu_data_residency.quote: 64000MB（新加坡、东京、硅谷、法兰克福、深圳金融、上海金融）
eu_data_residency.note: SCF is available in the Frankfurt (Germany/EU) region per Tencent Cloud's own quota-limit documentation and the card's fleet data, so functions/data can be kept in an EU region.

snapshot.quote: Because of the nature of SCF, you must write your function code in a stateless style. State characteristics in the lifecycle of a function such as local file storage will be destroyed after the function invocation ends.
snapshot.note: Corroborated by https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/583/9694: "The platform will repossess instances that have not processed requests for a certain period of time" (idle instances reclaimed, no checkpoint). Neither official doc mentions any snapshot/checkpoint feature; the SCF API's config types (VpcConfig, CfsConfig, PublicNetConfigIn) have no snapshot structure. Provisioned concurrency only pre-warms instances, which is not a snapshot. Tencent's separate Agent Runtime/Agent Sandbox (AGS) product advertises session snapshots, but that is a different product, not SCF. snapshot: "none" confirmed correct.

arm64.quote: SCF currently supports CPU and GPU computing power. ... The CPU processing capability of SCF is directly proportional to the function configuration memory.
arm64.note: not offered: outside the product's scope. SCF's 'Function Computing Power Support' page (the authoritative spec for compute options) only exposes a memory-proportional CPU-cores table (0.1 to 64 cores) and a fixed set of T4/A10 GPU instance types; no architecture/CPU-type selector (x86 vs ARM) is offered. The execution environment doc (product/583/9694) states the runtime is built on 'Standard CentOS 7.2' with no ARM variant mentioned. No SCF docs, release notes, or FAQs mention ARM/aarch64/Graviton-equivalent support.

hipaa.quote: Tencent Cloud releases self-assessment reports for HIPAA compliance, which explain its ability to protect users' personal information and the effectiveness of the control measures taken.
hipaa.note: HIPAA is listed as one of Tencent Cloud's platform-wide compliance certifications (www.tencentcloud.com/services/compliance-program lists a 'HIPAA' card: 'Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act'). This is an account/platform-level attestation (self-assessment reports covering ePHI handling), not an SCF-specific page, and is not phrased as an explicit signed BAA offer, so medium confidence rather than high.

usage_api.quote: 获取账单明细数据。...支持按ResourceId查询指定资源信息...支持按标签汇总费用分布
usage_api.note: granularity: per-sandbox; cost: yes; Tencent Cloud's Billing API (product/555) provides DescribeBillDetail endpoint that returns detailed billing records filtered by ResourceId (individual function), project, region, tag, and other dimensions. SCF functions are identifiable as resources and their billable usage (GB-seconds, invocations, egress traffic, cost) can be queried per-function or per-tag/label groupings. Returns cost in CNY or USD.
